facts.claim: The experimental plantation of coffee near Bangalore has led to land being taken up for coffee cultivation in the district.
facts.quote: The success which attended an experimental plantation of coffee near Bangalore has led to land being taken up of late years for the same purpose in maiddn parts of the District, but the enterprise has not yet passed out of the experimental stage.

facts.claim: The district cultivates a wide variety of vegetables and fruits for European markets in Bangalore and Madras.
facts.quote: Besides the productions of the country entered in the foregoing list, vegetables and fruits are raised in large quantities and great variety for the European markets at Bangalore and Madras.

facts.claim: In 1893, rice was cultivated on 49,419 acres in the district.
facts.quote: Rice, 49,419; rdgi, 357,448; wheat, 16; other food grains, 91,320; vegetables, 9,250; oilseeds, 15,139; sugar-cane, 3,159; cocoanut and areca nut, 8,943; tobacco, 1,148; mulberry, 30^7 ; fibres, 741.
